title: HyperDet: 3D Object Detection with Hyper 4D Radar Point Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2602.11554v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How far can 3D object detection go using 4D radar alone? Despite offering weather-robust and velocity- aware sensing for autonomous perception, modern 4D radar still yields sparse, noisy, and unstable point clouds, limiting radar-only 3D detection. We present HyperDet, a detector- agnostic input enhancement pipeline that constructs task- aware hyper 4D radar point clouds by combining measured observations with completed foreground geometry. HyperDet first refines short-window surround-view radar observations through spatio-temporal accumulation and cross-sensor val- idation, while Doppler-guided motion compensation reduces dynamic object trails when motion can be estimated reliably. It then performs foreground generative enhancement using LiDAR-guided pseudo-radar supervision available only during training, enriching object geometry while preserving measured radar background and radar-native attributes. translated_title: HyperDet：基于超4D雷达点云的3D目标检测
translated_abstract: 仅使用4D雷达，3D目标检测能达到什么程度？尽管现代4D雷达为自动驾驶感知提供了抗恶劣天气和速度感知的探测能力，但其点云仍然稀疏、嘈杂且不稳定，限制了仅基于雷达的3D检测。我们提出了HyperDet，这是一种与检测器无关的输入增强流水线，通过将实测观测与补全的前景几何相结合，构建任务感知的超4D雷达点云。HyperDet首先通过时空累积和跨传感器验证来优化短时窗环视雷达观测，同时在运动可被可靠估计时，利用多普勒引导的运动补偿来减少动态目标的拖尾。然后，它使用仅在训练期间可用的LiDAR引导的伪雷达监督进行前景生成式增强，在保留实测雷达背景和雷达原生属性的同时丰富目标几何信息。在检测器训练（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HyperDet提出了一种与检测器无关的输入增强流水线，通过时空累积、多普勒引导的运动补偿以及基于LiDAR监督的前景生成式增强来构建任务感知的超4D雷达点云，从而显著提升仅使用4D雷达的3D目标检测性能。
en_tdlr: HyperDet is a detector-agnostic input enhancement pipeline that constructs task-aware hyper 4D radar point clouds through spatio-temporal accumulation, Doppler-guided motion compensation, and LiDAR-guided foreground generative enhancement, significantly improving radar-only 3D object detection.
